verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud PaaS, so a local dev emulator that mirrors its production runtime is a fair capability to ask about, but the evidence pack documents none. The nearby features are all adjacent rather than local simulation: Docker support only lets users build their own local parity, while preview environments and short-lived service instances run on Render's cloud, not on the developer's machine.

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime
